# Legendary Metal Works Inc.

> Custom metal fabrication shop in Ventura, California. We design, weld, and install motorized driveway gates, iron railings and safety guardrails, metal front doors, fencing, and side gates for residential and commercial properties across Ventura County. Family-run, three generations, 25+ years, 500+ completed projects.

## Key facts

- **Rating:** 5.0 stars on Google
- **Founded:** Family business spanning three generations, 25+ years in operation
- **Fabrication:** All metalwork is built in our own Ventura workshop, not subcontracted or ordered from a supplier

## Service area

Ventura County and the western Los Angeles County line: Ventura, Oxnard, Thousand Oaks, Camarillo, Simi Valley, Moorpark, Westlake Village, Ojai, Calabasas, and Malibu.

## Services

- **Motorized driveway gates** — custom automatic sliding and swing gates, keypad entry, smartphone control, motor installation and repair
- **Iron railings and safety guardrails** — interior stair railings, balcony railings, guardrails for open stairwells, lofts and pony walls, ADA-compliant handrails, cable and glass railings
- **Metal front doors** — pivot, double, and arched custom entry doors
- **Fencing** — ornamental iron, tubular steel, pool-code compliant, privacy, and architectural fencing
- **Side gates** — pedestrian gates in wood-metal, full iron, and modern designs
- **Custom fabrication** — staircases, pergolas, awnings, security doors, architectural and artistic metalwork
- **Repairs and restoration** — existing metalwork, historic wrought iron, gate motor replacement

## Pricing

Pricing is quoted per project after a free on-site consultation, because cost depends on span, design complexity, material, motor selection, and finish. We do not publish fixed prices because no two gates or railings are the same size or design. Every customer receives a written estimate before work begins. Financing is available.

Typical cost drivers:
- **Driveway gates:** width of the opening, single swing vs. double swing vs. sliding, motor and access-control system, ornamental detail
- **Railings and guardrails:** total linear feet, straight vs. curved runs, infill style (picket, cable, glass), finish
- **Fencing:** linear footage, height, style, and whether pool-code compliance is required

## Common questions

**Do you build to California building code?** Yes. Guardrails, handrails, and pool-code fencing are built to current California Residential Code requirements, and we coordinate with local building departments when permits or inspections are required.

**Do you install what you build?** Yes. Fabrication and installation are both done by our own crew, not subcontracted.

**Do you offer free estimates?** Yes, free on-site consultations and written estimates throughout our service area.

**Do you repair existing metalwork?** Yes, including historic wrought iron restoration and gate motor replacement.
